instruction.text: Mark is walking around his village. Fill in the gaps to describe Mark’s movement from the pond to the bus stop.

atoms.b: Mark walked ((++forwards backwards)) to  the bus stop.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to describe Mark’s movement from the supermarket to the bus stop.

atoms.b: Mark made a ((++quarter half)) turn and walked in a straight line to the bus stop.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to describe Mark’s movement from school to the library.

atoms.b: Mark walked in a straight line and then made a ((++quarter half)) turn at the crossroads.
He then continued to walk ((++straight_ahead down)) to arrive at the library.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to describe Mark’s movement from school to the supermarket.

atoms.b: Mark made a ((++quarter full)) turn as he left school.
He then walked ((++forwards backwards)) to the supermarket.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to describe Mark’s movement from the park to the phone box.

atoms.b: Mark made a ((half ++quarter)) turn and walked in a straight line to the phone box.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to describe Mark’s movement from the phone box to the pond.

atoms.b: Mark made ((one ++two three)) turns to arrive at the pond.
